reps.prompt: Historical Context: The Growth of Self-Government in Colonial America. Task: Using information from the documents and your knowledge of United States history, write an essay in which you: • Describe the historical circumstances surrounding this constitutional or civic issue • Explain efforts by individuals, groups, and/or governments to address this constitutional or civic issue • Discuss the impact of the efforts on the United States and/or on American society. [Station IX drill: write ONE PEEL body paragraph using at least two documents.]
reps.station_focus: Drill the PEEL body paragraph: Point → Evidence (two named documents) → Explanation (the LINK — the ‘so what’) → tie back to the thesis. The Link is the move students skip.

reps.exemplar: Point: colonial Americans built their tradition of self-government on principles that reached back centuries before independence. Evidence: as early as 1215, Magna Carta established that the English king could not tax his subjects without the consent of a council representing the realm (Doc 1), and by 1639 the settlers of Connecticut had put that same principle into practice on American soil, writing the Fundamental Orders to elect their own governor and magistrates every year by the vote of the colony's freemen (Doc 2). Explanation: this matters because it shows self-government in the colonies was not a sudden invention of the 1760s — it was an old English right colonists had already been exercising, on their own soil, for well over a century before Parliament ever tried to tax them without asking. Link: that inherited expectation is exactly why 'no taxation without representation' read to colonists not as a new demand, but as a right five hundred years old being taken away.
reps.compare_focus: After you cite the two documents, write the sentence that explains WHY they prove your point ('this matters because…'). Stopping at the evidence is the 2→3 gap.
compare_checklist: Did I use two documents by name/detail, not just quote them?
Did I write an explicit Explanation sentence ('this shows/this matters because…')?
Did I tie the paragraph back to my thesis?
